topicA: AI's Impact on Search and Content Strategy
topicB: Data Quality and Signal Loss in B2B Marketing

recap.intro: This week you explored two fascinating areas of B2B marketing: how AI is reshaping search and content, and the critical importance of data quality in a world of signal loss.
bullets: Smart AI programs are changing how businesses manage their online content, but people still need to be in charge.
For your website to be found by new AI search tools, it's important to create really good content and be seen as a trusted source.
AI-driven purchases are growing fast, but online stores need to update their checkout to work for machines, not just people, to avoid problems.
The success of AI in marketing depends more on having good, clean data than on the AI itself, because bad data makes mistakes bigger and faster.
recap.closing: This week you learned that while AI is rapidly changing B2B marketing, human oversight and high-quality data are more crucial than ever for success.
